Name: Abiah, Wife of Hezron
Summary: Wife of Hezron after his death, named as the mother of Ashur.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:24: Wife of Hezron after his death, named as the mother of Ashur.
LifeLesson: The mention of Abiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
